title: Playing all birds fly and I say stoop and washing up dishes
html_source: Various games. For example, “I say stoop” is a game like Simon says, where you are out if you stoop when someone says “stoop” rather than “I say stoop”. Apparently “all birds fly” is a game in which you imitate birds? (Source: Penguin 20th c. Classics Annotated Students' Edition)
